title: Location of Pain
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. positions.as_written: Ask the patient to point with one finger to where it hurts most.
Ask whether the pain stays there or moves, since migrating pain behaves differently from fixed pain.
Ask whether there is more than one site, and if so which came first.
Ask the patient to point with one finger, and never offer a region.
